entities.summary: Heribert Barrera i Costa was a Catalan politician and chemist. A member of the Republican Left of Catalonia, he was the first President of the Parliament of Catalonia following the restoration of the Catalan institutions after Franco's dictatorship, serving from 1980 to 1984.
